value.rationale: The 2023 motivating work highlights insufficiency of local necessary conditions for finite BL extreme points and the importance of extremal test functions for Dudley dual norms. The new theorem determines every extreme function on a natural infinite family, proves all vertex coordinates rational on a sharply bounded denominator grid, and counts exponentially many vertices by O(n^3) integer additions without enumerating them. This algorithmic/combinatorial invariant is not a trivial renaming of a qualitative face criterion.
